GRADE 7 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERM 2 EXAM

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Time: 64 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

   C. Leadership in Israel is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Leadership in Israel.
